en.name: Fiend Patron
en.description: A pact with the lower planes.

3.name: Dark One's Blessing
3.description: When a foe near you drops to 0 HP: temporary HP = CHA + level.

3.name: Fiend Spells
3.description: Always prepared: e.g. burning hands, fireball.

6.name: Dark One's Own Luck
6.description: +1d10 to a check or save (CHA times per long rest).

10.name: Fiendish Resilience
10.description: After each rest, resistance to one damage type.

14.name: Hurl Through Hell
14.description: On a hit: the target is hurled through hell, 8d10 psychic damage.
